mapper.sql: strategy_id, account_id, name, symbol, strategy_type, short_window, long_window, band_window, band_width, quantity, max_spend, max_position, max_consecutive_failures, status, status_reason, spent, orders_placed, consecutive_failures, last_triggered_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM strategies WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
SELECT FROM strategies WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, strategy_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strategies WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('strategies:' || CAST(#{accountId} AS TEXT)))) AS locked
SELECT FROM strategies WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY strategy_id
SELECT FROM strategies WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE strategies SET spent = spent + #{spend}, orders_placed = orders_placed + 1, consecutive_failures = 0, last_triggered_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}

UPDATE strategies SET spent = spent + #{spend}, consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, status = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_consecutive_failures THEN 'HALTED' ELSE status END, status_reason = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_consecutive_failures THEN #{haltReason} ELSE status_reason END, last_triggered_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM strategies WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
